normal_policy: retain all 4 source_48khz_normal files in every viable plan
file_feature_policy: compute descriptors after deterministic common preprocessing; no target label/prediction input
stability_check: leave one source load hp among 0,1,2,3 and recompute subgroup ranking
selection_rule: hard coverage constraints first; if one subgroup ranks first in full data and at least 3 of 4 leave-one-load runs, MVP=that fault subgroup+all normals; otherwise MVP=union of top two full-data fault subgroups+all normals
alternative_rule: if MVP is one subgroup+normals, alternative=top two subgroups+normals; otherwise alternative=all three fault subgroups+normals
